description: Replace an assembly feature's payload — a mate's type, connectors or limits, a relation's ratio. Post the whole feature JSON, e.g. as onshape_get_assembly_features returns it, inside a BTFeatureDefinitionCall-1406 envelope.

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

feature_id.description: Id of the feature to replace.

validate.description: Re-read the feature list afterwards and fail if the feature regenerated with an error (default true).

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_update_assembly_feature
title: Update an assembly feature
